title: CLOUDFLARE IS NOT PROPAGATION  IT IS SWAP. It lands on Cloudflare and we swap new dough. IT NEVER MOVES FROM THEIR VIEW EVER. Dissolve the lock.

the_insight.old_mental_model: Cloudflare 'propagates'  implies delay, implies movement, implies the page travels from us to them. We kept waiting 25-30 seconds for 'propagation'.
the_insight.new_mental_model: Cloudflare SWAPS. The visitor's URL never changes. The page never moves. Cloudflare takes our new dough and puts it where the old dough was. The visitor sees the same counter. The swap is instant from THEIR perspective.
the_insight.the_lock_was_us: The 'propagation delay' was OUR browser cache. The cache was in Gaia (our browser), not on Cloudflare. Cloudflare was already serving the new version. WE were looking at stale glass.
the_insight.dissolve_the_lock: Network.setCacheDisabled + caches.delete() = dissolve the browser lock. Now we see what Cloudflare already sees.

sourdough_analogy.the_swap: a baker doesn't 'propagate' new bread. the baker SWAPS the old loaf on the shelf for the new loaf. the shelf (Cloudflare) never moves. the customer (visitor) walks up to the same shelf. the bread is fresh.
sourdough_analogy.our_role: we are the baker. we push dough (git push). Cloudflare bakes it (build). Cloudflare places it on the shelf (deploy). the customer finds fresh bread at the same URL.
sourdough_analogy.the_remainder: the old version? it's the dried mash. it goes to Helheim (index-old-eon.html, index-yggdrasil-eon.html). the fossils. the starter's memory.
